Medi-Cal Conlan Reimbursement Form DHCS 4521 Process
How out-of-pocket medical expense claims move from filing to statutory enforcement

1) Claim Eligibility
* Paid out-of-pocket during 3-month retroactive eligibility window
* Paid while waiting for Medi-Cal determination (Evaluation Period)
* Charged an incorrect Share of Cost or co-payment post-approval

2) Mandatory Document Packet
* Form DHCS 4521 with original wet-ink signature (blue/black ink only)
* Form STD 204 (Payee Data Record) & Medi-Cal BIC Card copy
* Itemized statement showing service dates and CPT codes
* Proof of payment (cancelled check, provider receipt, bank statement)

3) Submission Strategy (Clock-Start)
* Mail via USPS Certified Mail with Return Receipt
* Certified delivery date establishes official "Day 0" proof of receipt
* Route to BSC (Sacramento) or Medi-Cal Rx Claims Dept (Pharmacy)

4) Statutory Deadlines & Timelines
* Filing Deadline: 1 year from service date OR 90 days from BIC issue date
* Managed Care Plan Deadline: 30 calendar days (AB 3275 / HSC § 1371)
* State DHCS Timeline: 120 calendar days (WIC § 14019.3)

5) Administrative Default & Enforcement
Day 31+ Silence: If plan fails to act within 30 days, the claim defaults under AB 3275.
File protective Government Claim (Gov Code § 910) & DMHC complaint to exhaust administrative remedies.

This chart outlines statutory filing protocols under Welfare & Institutions Code § 14019.3.
